fusions.name: Hotfoot
fusions.desc: A kick with a burning foot that deals 9 fire damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. It burns you too, taking 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Friction Flashover
fusions.desc: Flame bursts from your tracks, dealing 30 fire damage that ignores resistance to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and setting them [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Scorched Trail
fusions.desc: Raises a line of flame 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Sparks at the Heels
fusions.desc: Every stretch of ground you cover, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
